effects.text: A message of up to twenty-five words to a creature you have met, within range, in contact with soil, roots or fungus; it may reply in twenty-five. It fails silently if the target cannot be reached.

warps.text: Send the same message to up to five eligible creatures

system.description:
LINGUISTIC PLANT UTILITY
Tradition verdant
Cast 1 minute (material, somatic)
Range 1 mile
Targets 1 creature you have met

You press your hands against soil, roots or fungal growth and release a message into the living network beneath the land.
If the target is within range, on the same plane and in contact with natural soil, roots or fungal growth, it receives a message of up to twenty-five words. The target may immediately reply with up to twenty-five words.
The spell fails without revealing why if the target cannot be reached through the natural world. Open ocean, wholly artificial environments and planar boundaries prevent transmission.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the range to 10 miles.
+4 PP: Increase the range to 100 miles.
+2 PP: Send the same message to up to five eligible creatures.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
